title: Chapter 26: Boss, You’re on TV
html:
A completion rate above ninety percent gives an extra reward?Chen Ge was initially delighted to have unlocked a hidden item, but his excitement faded as soon as he read its description.Wang Qi’s Missing-Person Notice? Did the black phone make a mistake? This sounds more like a curse than a reward.

Once he finished reading, another question occurred to him.What exactly are Malice Points?

From the wording, they appeared to measure the intensity of the resentment attached to an item.

A normal person has no use for something like that. Does that mean the item is meant for something that isn’t human?

Chen Ge glanced at the shadow trailing beside him, then shook the thought from his mind.

The police car reached New Century Park at around 7:00 a.m. Chen Ge borrowed the spare key to the Haunted House from the security guard. By the time he reached the staff break room, exhaustion had settled into every bone in his body.

His personal phone had died sometime during the night, which meant the livestream had ended on its own. He plugged it in and switched it back on.

The phone’s pedometer showed that he had logged more than ten thousand steps. He had somehow climbed to the top of his friends’ ranking, and Xu Wan had even liked the achievement.

I really should exercise more. Being able to run when it matters clearly has its advantages.

He found He San’s number and sent a message rather than risk waking him with a call. Less than three seconds later, He San called him instead.

“My god! Boss, you’re alive!” He San shouted loudly enough to make Chen Ge’s headache worse.

“You sound disappointed. And keep your voice down before you wake your roommates.”

“Wake them? None of us slept! We were all watching your stream, and we’ve been waiting to hear from you.”

For a moment, Chen Ge was genuinely touched. Then He San continued, “After the stream cut out, they were convinced something terrible had happened and started betting on whether you’d call back. Thanks, Boss. You just paid for my lunches this week.”

“So that’s what my wellbeing is worth to you—a few meals. You really didn’t need to share that part.” Chen Ge was once again defeated by He San’s brutal honesty.

“Anyway, I’m seriously glad you’re okay. You had all of us worried.”

“That is much better than whatever you were about to say next.” Chen Ge rubbed his temple. “You helped me a lot last night. I owe you a meal sometime.”

After hanging up, Chen Ge opened his profile on the video-sharing app and was startled to discover that he had gained more than three thousand followers.

Even an hour of black screen gained me followers?His private-message inbox was overflowing. Most of the messages asked some variation of the same question: “Host, are you still alive?”

These people sound almost disappointed that I made it back.

His Haunted House advertisement was still visible, and neither his stream nor his account had been suspended. Relieved, Chen Ge tossed the phone aside, buried his face in the pillow, and stretched out on the bed.

I’m shutting down. I have absolutely earned some sleep.

He changed into something comfortable, closed his eyes, and fell asleep almost immediately.

Morning brightened the room, sunlight spilling across the edge of the bed.

Bang!

The Haunted House entrance opened downstairs, followed by hurried footsteps on the stairs. A key turned in the staff-room lock and the door flew open.

A moment later, the bed jolted hard enough to wake him.

Chen Ge shot upright. Before he could form a question, something waved excitedly in front of his face and a familiar voice rang through the room.

“Boss, you’re on television!”

It took Chen Ge two full seconds to understand where he was. Xu Wan was sitting beside the bed, practically vibrating with excitement. He pulled the comforter higher and blinked at her. “Slow down. What about me?”

“Someone I actually know is on the news! They blurred your face, but I recognized you immediately.”

“Blurred my face?” Chen Ge was still trying to wake up.

“Look.” Xu Wan handed him her phone. “Someone uploaded this clip from Jiujiang Morning News. They added the story at the last minute.”

Chen Ge pressed play. Ping An Apartments appeared on the screen.

“Police have announced a major development in the Fu An Apartments case, in which four members of one family died several years ago. With information provided by a civilian witness, investigators have detained a key suspect.”

The report included a brief interview and a photograph of Chen Ge leaving the area with a police officer. His face had been heavily pixelated. A caption explained that because another suspect remained at large, the witness’s identity was being withheld for his protection.

“Boss, that’s you, right? You’re wearing the same clothes you had on yesterday!”

“Can I put on some clothes before the interrogation?” After getting dressed, Chen Ge gave Xu Wan a condensed version of what had happened at Ping An Apartments. He left out the black phone and claimed that he had gone there looking for inspiration for the Haunted House.

By the time he finished, Xu Wan’s excitement had turned to concern. “Boss, you must be exhausted. Go back to sleep. I can handle the visitors.”

She meant well, but the word visitors revived him instantly. “How many?”

“More than yesterday.”

“Then why are we standing here? Help me up.”

Chen Ge sent Xu Wan to wait by the entrance while he washed his face. Then he took out the black phone and opened the Murder by Midnight scenario page.

“Murder by Midnight (Scream Factor: 1 Star): Scenario completed. The new attraction is ready for inspection on the third floor.”

“Warning: The Haunted House is running out of usable interior space. Additional scenarios cannot be unlocked until the attraction is expanded.”

Chen Ge had expected days of preparation. Once again, he had underestimated what the black phone could do.When did it build the scenario?

He pulled on his shoes, hurried upstairs, and opened the third-floor door. The space beyond it was unrecognizable.

The old storage area had vanished. In its place stretched a long, oppressive corridor. Murder by Midnight occupied more than half of the third floor and appeared to connect with portions of Minghun below and Night of the Living Dead on the first floor.

So the Haunted House effectively has three levels now. The first two build people up, and the third is the real challenge. Why does it look so much like Ping An Apartments?
